description: Mozambique: Impact of Cyclones is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Mozambique. Impact of cyclones (people affected and injured by cyclones) in Mozambique from 2017 to 2026. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Mozambique. Its tags are affected population, africa, cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, natural disasters. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0) (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
